sets.description: The Monster: 524 White Border cards, tobacco backs, Hall of Famers, and variations.
sets.historicalOverview: Issued from 1909 to 1911 through American Tobacco Company brands, T206 is the classic prewar baseball checklist: broad, weird, beautiful, and famously difficult to complete.
sets.whyItMatters: T206 set collecting is where player runs, team runs, color runs, portrait hunts, and tobacco-back collecting all collide. It is Slabbed’s flagship set because it behaves like a complete collecting universe.
sets.sourceName: Library of Congress
sets.rightsNote: Library of Congress Rights Advisory: No known restrictions on publication.

sets.description: A compact 1911 tobacco-era checklist with gold borders, ornate typography, and a strong Hall of Fame lineup.
sets.historicalOverview: The 1911 T205 Gold Border set followed the T206 era with a smaller, more decorative checklist. Its gilt frame, league emblems, and compact subjects give it a museum-card feel.
sets.whyItMatters: T205 is a natural second Slabbed set: historically adjacent to T206, easier to understand as a complete checklist, visually distinct, and loaded with prewar stars.
